messages:
incident-bot: PAGE — SEV2: auth-proxy abnormal 401/403 spike detected from service token svc-analytics in us-west-2. Possible token reuse or misconfiguration. Aggregated 4,800 auth failures in 5m. Alerts: PagerDuty, rate > 3x baseline :rotating_light:

sophia: oncall-rotation can you take? I'm grabbing logs

oncall-rotation: taking it. pinging @mike and @raj for infra + sec

mike: seeing repeated 401s for svc-analytics across multiple pods. Sample from auth-proxy logs:
```
2026-03-15T14:12:03Z auth-proxy svc=svc-analytics err=401 msg="invalid token signature" src=10.40.2.11
2026-03-15T14:12:04Z auth-proxy svc=svc-analytics err=401 msg="token expired" src=10.40.2.12
``` 
but some show valid exp, signature ok

raj: if signature ok but intermittent 401, could be clock skew or token replay. Any recent key changes?

mike: no key changes in last 72h. KMS rotation scheduled but not applied. token creation time distribution looks normal. Running quick query for identical jti across requests

sophia: @elaine any customer reports or visible errors in dashboards?

elaine: a few customers reported auth failures hitting embeddings endpoint; small percentage ~0.6% errors, not widespread yet. Support ticket 4521 opened. No PII observed in leaked logs we checked but need full audit.

raj: preemptive containment: advise rotating svc-analytics token, revoke active sessions tied to it, and add temporary WAF rule to block suspicious src IPs. Also gather access logs for last 24h and flag any exfil patterns.

oncall-rotation: agreed. mike, do we have an automated token rotation path for service tokens? If not, we'll do manual revoke and reissue.

mike: we have a script: `scripts/rotate_service_token.sh svc-analytics` — will run in canary (one region) first. Running now in us-west-2. I'll post output.

mike: canary rotate in progress... output:
```
rotating token for svc-analytics -> new token issued at 2026-03-15T14:16:21Z
propagating to auth-cache nodes (0/4)
propagate: ok (4/4)
``` 

sophia: thanks. @support-team please escalate any customer blocks and attach temporary mitigation steps (retry with new token once available).

raj: also recommend immediate session revocation for tokens issued in last 48h tied to svc-analytics jti pattern `^anlz-[0-9a-f]{8}`. I will open a ticket for the audit team.

elaine: product note — we should enable a safe fallback for embed requests so UX retries on 401 with exponential backoff and a clear error message for customers.

oncall-rotation: WAF rule applied to block top 5 suspicious IPs for 1h. Monitor.

incident-bot: NOTE — audit-log-export job started; ETA 12m. link: https://redwood.internal/audit/exports/2417001234

mike: rotation complete in all regions. New token rolled, old token revoked via auth-service. Auth metrics dropping back to baseline in us-west-2.

sophia: verified KV cache invalidation succeeded. No further 401 spikes for 10m.

elaine: support notified customers affected (7 orgs) — messages sent with mitigation steps and ETA for full investigation.

raj: collecting indicators of compromise. So far no sign of data exfil or access to customer content. Still continue full log review and search for suspicious lateral auth attempts.

oncall-rotation: handoff to sec oncall @raj for follow-up. leaving channel at 14:42Z. thanks team :thumbsup:

raj: taking over. Will coordinate postmortem and timeline. Requesting all involved to upload their notes to the incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2417001234/doc

sophia: will paste raw query snippets and graphs into doc.

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS -> downgraded to MONITORING at 2026-03-15T14:43:00Z. Suspected cause: compromised/reused service token. Actions: token rotation, session revocation, temporary IP blocking, audit started. Next: sec-led investigation and postmortem.

elaine: ETA for sec report 48h. I'll draft a customer update in 4h

raj: ack. closing oncall handoff. If anything resurfaces ping here or page sec-oncall. closing thread shortly.
